page_title: REI 0-3 PSG | Reims v PSG 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Close! Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
86' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the crossbar.
83' It is time for a substitution. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) is on for Mohamed Daramy.

82' 0 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Bradley Barcola, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG), who beats Yehvann Diouf with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 0:3.
81' Junya Ito (Reims) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
81' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) replacing Carlos Soler.
79' Paris SG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cher Ndour (Paris SG) will replace Kang-In Lee.
77' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
75' William Still decides to make a substitution. Thibault De Smet will be replaced by Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims).
75' The resulting corner, taken by Kang-In Lee (Paris SG), comes to nothing.
74' Now Paris SG have a corner.
74' Substitution. Ousmane Dembele did his best and is replaced by Bradley Barcola (Paris SG).
73' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Paris SG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

72' That didn't go as planned! Mohamed Daramy (Reims) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Gianluigi Donnarumma, who easily kept it out.
70' William Still has decided to substitute Thomas Foket and he is replaced by Reda Khadra (Reims).
70' Substitution. Amir Richardson makes way for Oumar Diakite (Reims).
69' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
68' A quickly taken corner by Paris SG.

67' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
63' Vitinha (Paris SG) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
61' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Marshall Munetsi, who fails to shoot.
59' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Carlos Soler is the provider as he slips the ball to Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 0:2.
57' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
56' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
56' Junya Ito (Reims) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
54' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
52' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
51' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) sees a yellow card from Willy Delajod after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' Luis Enrique makes a switch. Vitinha (Paris SG) is coming on in place of Goncalo Ramos at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Reims was in an offside position.

41' Well-positioned Amir Richardson (Reims) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
40' There's an opportunity for Junya Ito (Reims) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
37' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner with a short pass.
37' Junya Ito (Reims) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Reims win a corner kick.
35' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
34' Close! Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Reims.

30' Junya Ito (Reims) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off an easy save.
29' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
24' The percentage of ball possession is – 40:60.
20' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
18' Some neat passing and movement from Paris SG as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
14' A snap shot by Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Yehvann Diouf produces a good save to thwart him.
8' The goal by Reims won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
8' The Reims players halt their celebrations as referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
8' Goal! Mohamed Daramy plays a simple square pass into the feet of Junya Ito (Reims) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
6' Reims earn a corner.
3' 0 - 1 Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) meets a perfect cross from Ousmane Dembele deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Paris SG will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
